page.notes: Two index columns; the cross-references in the Latin text (e.g. "l.1r0", "l.31.E.", "in pr. E.de") are copied as printed. Some digits are uncertain in the scan, notably "l.1r0" (possibly l.110) and "tol'icur" (likely tollitur); these are left as printed. The left column's first line runs from the previous page, so it has no cont marker as it is a list, not running prose. The catchword "de Fi-" is part of the last line and is kept there as a hyphenated word break, not as a separate catchword.
